import collections,copy,datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,platform,resource,signal,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time
ROOT=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('RULE30_REPLAY_ROOT','/home/ryan/rule30-lab'))
OUT=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('RULE30_REPLAY_OUTPUT',str(ROOT/'results/problem1/20260905_zero_cost_return_verification.json')))
START=time.monotonic();resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1<<30,1<<30));resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(120,120));signal.alarm(120)
aff=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0));os.sched_setaffinity(0,{aff[0]})
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def canon(x):return json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
def originalbytes(x):return (json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
base=ROOT/'results/problem1';pp=base/'20260905_zero_cost_return_primary.json';ip=base/'20260905_zero_cost_return_independent.json'
p=json.loads(pp.read_bytes());i=json.loads(ip.read_bytes());s=i['result_summary'];data=p['result_summary']['data'];oldr=p['original_run_record']
for r in [p,i]:
    assert sha(canon(r['result_summary']))==r['result_hashes']['result_summary_sha256']
    assert sha(r['source_text'].encode())==r['result_hashes']['source_sha256']
assert p['result_summary']['completed'] and s['completed'] and not s['failures']
assert p['git_commit']==i['git_commit']==oldr['git_commit']
assert sha(originalbytes(oldr))==p['integration']['original_record_sha256']
assert sha(originalbytes(data))==p['integration']['original_raw_sha256']==oldr['result_hashes']['raw_data_sha256']
assert sha(oldr['executed_source_utf8'].encode())==oldr['result_hashes']['executed_source_sha256']
assert sha(canon(oldr['result_summary']))==oldr['result_hashes']['normalized_summary_sha256']
q=copy.deepcopy(oldr);h=q.pop('payload_sha256_excluding_this_field');assert sha(canon(q))==h
for path,info in i['inputs'].items():assert sha((ROOT/path).read_bytes())==info['sha256']
priorpath=base/'20260905_history_potential_primary.json';priorbytes=priorpath.read_bytes();prior=json.loads(priorbytes)
assert sha(priorbytes)==oldr['inputs']['operative_stored903_certificate']['sha256']
assert data['input903_six_step_certificate']==prior['result_summary']['data']['scope903']['fixed_motif']
assert sha(canon(data['input903_six_step_certificate']))==oldr['inputs']['operative_stored903_certificate']['selected_certificate_sha256']

MOD=1<<14;TARGET=903;LETTERS='tup';S=('t','u','p','p')
def G(g,v):
    t=v^((v<<1)|(v<<2));return t if g=='t' else t^1 if g=='u' else t^1^(2 if v%2==0 else 0)
def forbidden(q,g):return (q%16==0 and g=='t') or (q%16==1 and g=='u')
edges=[];graph=[];distance=s['reverse_distances'];assert len(distance)==MOD and distance[TARGET]==0
assert all(d>=0 and (d==0)==(q==TARGET) for q,d in enumerate(distance))
for q in range(MOD):
    row=[]
    for g in LETTERS:
        if not forbidden(q,g):
            y=G(g,q)%MOD;row.append((g,y));edges.append([q,g,y]);assert distance[q]<=distance[y]+1
    if q!=TARGET:assert any(distance[y]==distance[q]-1 for g,y in row)
    graph.append(row)
assert len(edges)==47104==s['zero_cost_edges'] and sha(canon(edges))==s['graph_edge_hash']
assert {str(k):v for k,v in collections.Counter(distance).items()}==s['distance_histogram']
iw={r['phase']:r for r in s['witnesses']};pw={r['phase']:r for r in data['witnesses']}
visited=traversed=0
for b in data['phase_graphs']:
    a=b['phase'];w=iw[a];nodes=b['nodes'];visited+=len(nodes)
    assert b['status']=='target_found' and len({r[0] for r in nodes})==len(nodes)==b['visited_node_count']
    assert sha(canon(nodes))==b['visited_discovery_table_sha256']
    assert sha(canon(sorted(r[0] for r in nodes)))==b['visited_sorted_residues_sha256']
    assert nodes[0]==[w['root'],-1,-1,0]
    for idx,(q,parent,gi,d) in enumerate(nodes[1:],1):
        assert 0<=parent<idx and d==nodes[parent][3]+1
        assert not forbidden(nodes[parent][0],LETTERS[gi]) and G(LETTERS[gi],nodes[parent][0])%MOD==q
    tested=set();skipped=set()
    for src,gi,q,dest,fresh in b['traversed_edges']:
        assert (src,gi) not in tested;tested.add((src,gi));traversed+=1
        assert not forbidden(nodes[src][0],LETTERS[gi])
        assert q==G(LETTERS[gi],nodes[src][0])%MOD==nodes[dest][0]
    for src,gi in b['forbidden_edges']:
        assert forbidden(nodes[src][0],LETTERS[gi]);skipped.add((src,gi))
    expected={(idx,gi) for idx,mask in b['expanded_rows'] for gi in range(3) if mask&(1<<gi)}
    assert tested.isdisjoint(skipped) and tested|skipped==expected
    assert b['target_distance']==distance[w['root']]==w['nonroot_length']
    assert b['shortest_zero_cost_rooted_word']==w['word_from_zero']
    assert [nodes[j][0] for j in b['target_path_node_indices']]==w['residue_path']
    q=w['root'];chosen=''
    while q!=TARGET:
        g,q=next((g,y) for g,y in graph[q] if distance[y]==distance[q]-1);chosen+=g
    assert a+chosen==w['word_from_zero']
assert traversed==23407

edgekeys=[str(q)+g for q in range(16) for g in LETTERS];state_count=step_count=0
for a,w in iw.items():
    r=pw[a];states=w['states'];assert len(states)==7
    assert r['initial_word']==w['word_from_zero'] and r['initial_integer_hex']==hex(w['original_x'])
    assert r['complexity']==w['k'] and r['nonroot_length']==w['nonroot_length']
    assert r['states_hex']==[state['endpoint_hex'] for state in states]
    assert [int(x,16) for x in r['initial_prefixes_from_zero_hex'][1:]]==states[0]['prefix_endpoints']
    assert r['actual_observed_branches']=='ututut' and r['admissibility_word']=='utututu' and not r['appended_final_u_observed']
    for t,state in enumerate(states):
        c=r['initial_counts'] if t==0 else r['steps'][t-1]['new_counts'];state_count+=1
        assert c['counts48']==[state['edge_counts'][e] for e in edgekeys]
        assert c['Wstar']==state['W_star']
    for t,row in enumerate(r['steps']):
        assert row['old_word'][1:]==states[t]['word_after_root'] and row['old_endpoint_hex']==states[t]['endpoint_hex']
        assert row['new_word'][1:]==states[t+1]['word_after_root'] and row['new_endpoint_hex']==states[t+1]['endpoint_hex']
        assert row['branch']==states[t]['branch']=='ututut'[t]
        assert [int(v,16) for v in row['new_word_prefixes_from_zero_hex'][1:]]==states[t+1]['prefix_endpoints'];step_count+=1
    assert r['delta48']==[states[6]['edge_counts'][e]-states[0]['edge_counts'][e] for e in edgekeys]
    assert w['W_star_values']==[0,1 if a=='p' else 0]
assert data['input903_six_step_certificate']['states']==s['representative_gate_check']['states']
# Exact low-level image grammar: no new history search.
u_first=[G(g,1) for g in LETTERS];p_first=[G(g,3) for g in LETTERS];p_next=[G(g,13) for g in LETTERS]
assert u_first==[7,6,6] and {S[v%4] for v in u_first}=={'p'}
assert {v for v in p_first if S[v%4]=='u'}=={13}
assert p_next==[51,50,50] and {S[v%4] for v in p_next}=={'p'}
assert iw['u']['states'][0]['word_after_root'].startswith('t')
assert iw['p']['states'][0]['word_after_root'].startswith('ut')
assert all(w['nonroot_length']>=3 for w in iw.values())
oldblock=prior['result_summary']['data']['genuine']['six_step_block']
oldstep=prior['result_summary']['data']['genuine']['full_seven_step_history_replay']['steps'][0]
assert oldblock['initial_endpoint']==oldstep['new_endpoint']==iw['u']['original_x']
x=oldstep['old_endpoint'];assert x==0x642fdfb and x%16==11
assert G('t',G('p',x>>2))==iw['u']['original_x']
old_rows=prior['result_summary']['data']['mod16']['all48_edge_rows']
assert len(old_rows)==48
old_counts=[0]*48;old_prefix=1
assert oldblock['initial_word'][0]=='u'
for letter in oldblock['initial_word'][1:]:
    old_counts[3*(old_prefix%16)+LETTERS.index(letter)]+=1
    old_prefix=G(letter,old_prefix)
assert old_prefix==iw['u']['original_x']
for index,row in enumerate(old_rows):
    assert row['index']==index and row['old_prefix_mod16']==index//3
    assert row['input_letter']==LETTERS[index%3] and row['initial_count']==old_counts[index]
assert old_counts[0]+old_counts[4]==2
assert oldblock['final_word'][1:]==iw['u']['states'][6]['word_after_root']
ref=sha((ROOT/'src/python/rule30_research_reference.py').read_bytes());assert ref=='358bdc07904e77080eb78b67bdd8da25822d6b51f1a91b58b5313dfe461c1d01'
summary={'completed':True,'failures':[],'graph_vertices_verified':MOD,'graph_edges_verified':len(edges),
         'reverse_distance_certificate_verified':True,'all_vertices_can_reach_target':True,
         'forward_nodes_checked':visited,'forward_edges_checked':traversed,
         'per_phase_minimal_zero_cost_lengths':{'p':distance[3],'u':distance[1]},
         'witness_states_compared':state_count,'witness_forced_steps_compared':step_count,'edge_count_tables_compared':state_count,
         'W_star_values':{'p':[0,1],'u':[0,0]},'one_step_image_prefix_obstructions_verified':True,
         'u_prescribed_initial_W_star_mod16':old_counts[0]+old_counts[4],
         'u_endpoint_is_prior_forced_successor':True,'u_prescribed_and_zero_word_have_same_endpoint':True,
         'minimized_endpoint_potential':{'initial_values':{'p':0,'u':0},'final_value_bounds':{'p':[0,1],'u':[0,0]},
                                       'basis':'Nonnegativity and displayed zero/upper-bound attainers; not an enumeration of all representations.'},
         'original_payload_source_raw_and_input_hashes_verified':True,'immutable_reference_sha256':ref}
